mapper.select: SELECT id, mall_id, floor_id, node_type, name, is_accessible, sort_order, remark FROM nav_node WHERE mall_id = #{mallId} AND deleted = 0 AND is_accessible = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nav_node (id, mall_id, floor_id, node_type, name, geom, is_accessible, sort_order, remark, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{mallId}, #{floorId}, #{nodeType}, #{name}, ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{geomGeoJson}), 0), #{isAccessible}, #{sortOrder}, #{remark}, now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE nav_node SET geom = ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{geomGeoJson}), 0), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, mall_id, floor_id, node_type, name, ST_AsGeoJSON(geom) AS geom_geo_json, is_accessible, sort_order, remark FROM nav_node WHERE mall_id = #{mallId} AND floor_id = #{floorId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order, id
